name: Voxel Occupancy Mask
definition: An optimization for the brick-level traversal where each brick's voxel occupancy is stored as a 64-bit bitmask (two 32-bit words) instead of a single occupancy bit. This allows skipping empty voxels within an occupied brick without texture lookups.
summary: Voxel Occupancy Mask is a brick-level ray traversal optimization using 64-bit bitmasks to skip empty voxels without texture lookups, differing from DDA by using finer 4x4x4 bricks.
